<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"

                  id="Definitions_Internship"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/internship">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Offer" name="Internship offer"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Acceptance" name="Offer acceptance"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Decline" name="Offer decline"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Tweet" name="Recommendation tweet"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Internship">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Applicant" name="You" processRef="Process_Applicant"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Company" name="Company" processRef="Process_Company"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Twitter" name="Twitter"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Offer" name="Offers" sourceRef="Participant_Company" targetRef="Event_OfferReceived" messageRef="Message_Offer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Acceptance" name="Acceptance" sourceRef="Task_SendAcceptance" targetRef="Event_AcceptanceReceived" messageRef="Message_Acceptance"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Decline" name="Decline" sourceRef="Task_SendDecline" targetRef="Participant_Company" messageRef="Message_Decline"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Tweet" name="Recommendation tweets" sourceRef="Task_SendTweet" targetRef="Participant_Twitter" messageRef="Message_Tweet"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Applicant" name="Internship" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Applicant">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Applicant" name="You">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_Internship</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterTopicAndMoney</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_OptionalDetails</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterExperienceAndHobbies</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_OptionalDetailsMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_OfferReceived</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_OfferDecision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendDecline</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendAcceptance</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_InvalidateOtherOffers</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_Week1</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_StatusUpdate1</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_Week2</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_StatusUpdate2</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_Week3</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_StatusUpdate3</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_InternshipFinished</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_NextWeek</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_FurtherStatusUpdate</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Recommend</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendTweet</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Recommended</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_NotRecommended</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Internship" name="Begin internship search"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnterTopicAndMoney" name="Enter topic of interest and desired amount"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OptionalDetails" name="Enter experience and hobbies?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnterExperienceAndHobbies" name="Enter experience and hobbies"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OptionalDetailsMerge" name="Continue to offers"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_OfferReceived" name="Offer arrives">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Offer" messageRef="Message_Offer"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OfferDecision" name="Accept or deny offer?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendDecline" name="Deny offer" messageRef="Message_Decline"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendAcceptance" name="Accept offer" messageRef="Message_Acceptance"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InvalidateOtherOffers" name="Invalidate all other offers"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_Week1" name="One week passes">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerDefinition_Week1">
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">P7D</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_StatusUpdate1" name="Write status update 1"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_Week2" name="One week passes">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerDefinition_Week2">
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">P7D</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_StatusUpdate2" name="Write status update 2"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_Week3" name="One week passes">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerDefinition_Week3">
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">P7D</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_StatusUpdate3" name="Write status update 3"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InternshipFinished" name="Internship finished?"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_NextWeek" name="One week passes">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerDefinition_NextWeek">
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">P7D</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FurtherStatusUpdate" name="Write further weekly status update"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Recommend" name="Recommend the company?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendTweet" name="Send recommendation tweet to a friend" messageRef="Message_Tweet">
      <bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics isSequential="false">
        <bpmn:loopCardinality xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">numberOfFriends</bpmn:loopCardinality>
      </bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Recommended" name="Recommendations sent"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NotRecommended" name="Internship completed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A1" sourceRef="Start_Internship" targetRef="Task_EnterTopicAndMoney"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A2" sourceRef="Task_EnterTopicAndMoney" targetRef="Gateway_OptionalDetails"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A3" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_OptionalDetails" targetRef="Task_EnterExperienceAndHobbies">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">enterExperienceAndHobbies</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A4" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_OptionalDetails" targetRef="Gateway_OptionalDetailsMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not enterExperienceAndHobbies</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A5" sourceRef="Task_EnterExperienceAndHobbies" targetRef="Gateway_OptionalDetailsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A6" sourceRef="Gateway_OptionalDetailsMerge" targetRef="Event_OfferReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A7" sourceRef="Event_OfferReceived" targetRef="Gateway_OfferDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A8" name="Deny" sourceRef="Gateway_OfferDecision" targetRef="Task_SendDecline">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">offerAccepted = false</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A9" name="Accept" sourceRef="Gateway_OfferDecision" targetRef="Task_SendAcceptance">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">offerAccepted = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A10" sourceRef="Task_SendDecline" targetRef="Event_OfferReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A11" sourceRef="Task_SendAcceptance" targetRef="Task_InvalidateOtherOffers"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A12" sourceRef="Task_InvalidateOtherOffers" targetRef="Event_Week1"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A13" sourceRef="Event_Week1" targetRef="Task_StatusUpdate1"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A14" sourceRef="Task_StatusUpdate1" targetRef="Event_Week2"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A15" sourceRef="Event_Week2" targetRef="Task_StatusUpdate2"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A16" sourceRef="Task_StatusUpdate2" targetRef="Event_Week3"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A17" sourceRef="Event_Week3" targetRef="Task_StatusUpdate3"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A18" sourceRef="Task_StatusUpdate3" targetRef="Gateway_InternshipFinished"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A19" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_InternshipFinished" targetRef="Gateway_Recommend">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">internshipFinished</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A20" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_InternshipFinished" targetRef="Event_NextWeek">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not internshipFinished</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A21" sourceRef="Event_NextWeek" targetRef="Task_FurtherStatusUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A22" sourceRef="Task_FurtherStatusUpdate" targetRef="Gateway_InternshipFinished"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A23" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Recommend" targetRef="Task_SendTweet">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">recommendCompany</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A24" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Recommend" targetRef="End_NotRecommended">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not recommendCompany</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A25" sourceRef="Task_SendTweet" targetRef="End_Recommended"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Company" name="Company status updates" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Company">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Company" name="Company">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_AcceptanceReceived</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CompanyUpdate1</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CompanyUpdate2</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CompanyUpdate3</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_CompanyUpdates</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Event_AcceptanceReceived" name="Offer accepted">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Acceptance" messageRef="Message_Acceptance"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompanyUpdate1" name="Write status update 1 about the intern"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompanyUpdate2" name="Write status update 2 about the intern"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompanyUpdate3" name="Write status update 3 about the intern"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_CompanyUpdates" name="Company status updates completed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C1" sourceRef="Event_AcceptanceReceived" targetRef="Task_CompanyUpdate1"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C2" sourceRef="Task_CompanyUpdate1" targetRef="Task_CompanyUpdate2"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C3" sourceRef="Task_CompanyUpdate2" targetRef="Task_CompanyUpdate3"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C4" sourceRef="Task_CompanyUpdate3" targetRef="End_CompanyUpdates"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_NextWeek</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C1" sourceRef="Start_CompanyUpdates" targetRef="Task_CompanyUpdate1"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C3" sourceRef="Task_CompanyUpdate2" targetRef="Task_CompanyUpdate3"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C4" sourceRef="Task_CompanyUpdate3" targetRef="End_CompanyUpdates"/>
  </bpmn:process>

rules.instruction: When the description says that a participant performs an action that initiates the process: Model the process trigger with a start event, then model the participant’s described action as a distinct task; do not use the action itself as the start event.
rules.situation: the description says that a participant enters information as part of beginning a process

rules.instruction: When the description distinguishes an event or activity by its action, actor, object, recipient, or another meaningful qualifier: Label each BPMN element so that it preserves those stated details without substituting a broader or different meaning.
rules.situation: the description distinguishes a modeled activity, event, or decision by its action, actor, object, recipient, quantity, frequency, or another meaningful qualifier

rules.instruction: When the description says a participant can enter or provide information before later process actions: Model the information-entry step as an activity, not as a start event.
rules.situation: the description says a participant can enter or provide information before later process actions

rules.instruction: When the description says an optional activity may occur after an outcome, and each occurrence is followed by another specified activity: Model the optional activity as a task on one branch of an exclusive gateway, with the other branch ending or continuing as described; connect the activity back to the specified later activity when it must follow each occurrence.
rules.situation: the description says an activity may be performed optionally after the required process has reached an outcome

rules.instruction: When the description specifies an activity’s object, recipient, or other meaningful qualifier: Preserve that qualifier in the BPMN task label rather than replacing it with a broader paraphrase.
rules.situation: the description states an activity or decision with a meaningful qualifier, such as its recipient, quantity, timing, or scope
